fact: The DGI's 2025 activity report shows electronic filing at 100% for corporate income tax, business profits tax, VAT, domestic excise and payroll tax, with electronic payment at 96.81% to 99.28% of transactions for those taxes, and e-services extended to the small-business tax centres of Abomey-Calavi, Porto-Novo and Parakou in 2025.
title: Fiscalité béninoise: Le numérique révolutionne la mobilisation des recettes
